claim_one_line: THE GLOBAL FORM IS PATH-INDEPENDENT, AND THAT IS WHY IT IS NOT NEW (the crux cell the prior-art dossier isolated; owner-directed; never asked before -- already_banked returns no settled arc on its terms). THE QUESTION: B862 forces the SM's global form to Z6, resolving an ambiguity the SM's own data cannot (Tong 1705.01853 leaves Gamma in {1,Z2,Z3,Z6}); Z6-given-SU(5) is known since 1980 at latest; so everything turned on whether Z6 is obtained on B994's descent chains that NEVER ENTER SU(5) (the SU(3)^3 / Pati-Salam routes). THE COMPUTATION: the kernel is a property of an (algebra, representation) pair and NOT of a path, so the question is settled without tracing chains -- compute the subgroup of Z(SU(3)) x Z(SU(2)) x U(1)_Y acting trivially on every component of the 27, from triality, duality and hypercharge alone. Integer normalisation y = 6Y is REQUIRED (with Y in sixths the U(1) action is ill-defined; the first run returned a trivial kernel for exactly that reason and was caught by the answer being absurd, not by care). RESULT: kernel on the 27 = order 6, cyclic, generator (omega, -1, e^{2pi i/6}) -- Z6 EXACTLY; the same 6 from the 16 alone and from the 10 alone. MB12 CONTROLS PASS: adjoint-only content gives 72, integer-charge-only content gives 18, so Z6 is a DISCRIMINATING outcome and not the only thing the instrument can say. THE ANSWER: YES, Z6 IS PATH-INDEPENDENT -- SU(5) appears NOWHERE in the computation, so any chain landing the SM algebra on the 27 yields Z6, through trinification, Pati-Salam or SU(5) alike. B862's claim is TRUE AND STRONGER THAN STATED. AND THAT IS PRECISELY WHY IT IS NOT NEW: the kernel is fixed by the MATTER REPRESENTATION, and 'the SM's matter content is Z6-invariant' IS the standard fact -- the same one that makes SU(5) quantise hypercharge. Path-independence does not rescue novelty; it EXPLAINS the 1980 result by showing the SU(5) embedding was never doing the work. The mechanism is representation-theoretic and classical. WHERE THE PROGRAMME'S CONTRIBUTION ACTUALLY SITS: not in the Z6, which follows from the content, but in DELIVERING the content -- and THE PAPER's own section 5 already concedes on the weakest reading that the SM-shaping is an INPUT, while section 4's anomaly computation contains NO TOKEN OF THE OBJECT. So the contribution is upstream of the Z6, in exactly the place the paper had already priced as external. DOSSIER CONSEQUENCE: Entry 4 = KNOWN. Genuinely untested remains Entry 1(iii), the metallic conjunction (no prior art found), and Entries 2-3 (unsearched). Gate 5 clean.
